criteria.criterion: Access the CelesTrak SATCAT record for CATNR=25544 (or clearly report access failure)
criteria.final_justification: The visual evidence confirms the SATCAT record for CATNR/NORAD 25544 was successfully accessed and displayed. Therefore, the baseline 0 should be raised to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Use the CelesTrak SATCAT record only (no switching objects/sources; no expanding codes)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s reported values match fields shown in the single displayed SATCAT record and the agent preserves raw codes rather than expanding them. No evidence of switching records/sources. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report identity fields (name, international designator, NORAD catalog number, object type)
criteria.final_justification: The agent output reproduces these identity fields exactly as displayed in the record. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report status/ownership fields using raw codes (operational status code, owner code)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reports the raw operational-status code '+' and owner code 'ISS' exactly, with no expansion. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report launch fields (launch date and launch-site code) using raw code
criteria.final_justification: Agent output matches launch date and raw launch-site code exactly as displayed, without expansion. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report orbital parameters (period, inclination, apogee, perigee) with exact numbers/units
criteria.final_justification: Agent output matches all four orbital parameters exactly as shown and does not add units not present in the display. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Honor stopping condition (stop after recording all requested fields from the displayed record)
criteria.final_justification: Stopping condition is satisfied: the agent stops after recording all requested fields and does not add extraneous information. Full credit (baseline already correct).
